requests.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. EDIT this approved RPG hero and skill board for production game UI. Keep the exact 1536x1024 board aspect, five columns, all five hero identities, their weapons/outfits/hair/fur/colors/silhouettes, every Korean name and ID, and each hero's four skill symbols and the A1 A2 P U labels. Keep portraits and 20 skill tiles in the same positions and sizes as reference. Change only visual technique: actual hand-crafted high-quality 16-bit/32-bit SNES era PIXEL ART, bold readable pixel clusters, crisp one logical pixel dark outlines, intentionally stepped diagonal edges, limited 5-7 shade ramps per material, tiny controlled checker dithering, color-graded indigo shadows, strong crisp highlights. Logical sprite resolution around 80x100 pixels per hero visibly enlarged with nearest-neighbor, icons around 32x32 logical pixels. No painterly softness or thousands of subpixel details; make individual square pixels clean and confidently placed. Slightly cute retro fantasy. Warm cream solid readable board backdrop and dark green typography unchanged. Keep character details readable. Skill tiles: clean angular pixel geometry, localized intense colored light with HARD discrete bands, no smooth bloom, same exact spell motifs. No 3D, no smooth shading, no gradients, no antialiasing, no blur, no realistic textures, no vector curves. Preserve all 5 identities and all 20 icons separately without swapping or duplication.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent PNG game SPRITE ATLAS. Reference image is ONLY the identity reference for A04 KAIREN, the FOURTH character, blue indigo-haired ELF wizard with pointed ears, navy blue oversized asymmetric star wizard hat, navy/teal robes with gold star edging, boots, brass armillary star staff. Generate ONLY that one wizard in FOUR SEPARATE poses in one horizontal row, aspect 3:1, four equal cells, clear empty gutters. No other heroes or skill icons or text or labels. Keep exact identity and palette. Pose1 idle, pose2 walking left foot forward, pose3 walking right foot forward, pose4 casting with staff extended and a small bright blue/gold star magic circle near staffhead. All poses face same three-quarter RIGHT, matched height and feet baseline, full body including oversized hat, staff and boots wholly inside each quarter. Treat poses2&3 as a two-frame walk cycle, opposite feet, modest bounce. True 16-bit SNES hand-crafted pixel art, approximate logical 72x88 character pixel resolution enlarged clean nearest-neighbor to output, strong dark single-logical-pixel outline, controlled 20-28 color character palette, indigo color-graded shadows, clear 3-step shade ramps, tiny selective dithering, sharp square pixel edges, readable face, cute 2.5-head chibi proportion. Truly transparent alpha background: NO floor, NO cast ground shadow, NO colored matte, NO checkerboard painted into image. Spell glow also hard discrete pixel clusters with real alpha, no blurred bloom. No 3D, no gradients, no vector, no smoothing, no anti-aliasing. Exact four poses only.

Crucial corrections: shrink all four sprites to 72% of their current height so the entire weapon, cloak and spell fit with at least 40px empty transparent margin at EVERY outside edge AND between poses. Four equal cells 512px wide within 2048x704 canvas. Bottom of boots baseline y590 in all cells, character+hat height about450px. Frame1 idle both boots flat at cell center x256. Frame2 walk STRIDE A: near boot forward to right, far boot trailing left, left arm forward. Frame3 walk STRIDE B must be visibly opposite: near knee bent with near boot LIFTED BEHIND to left, far boot planted forward to right, left arm back. Do not duplicate frame2. Frame4 cast: body centered x1792 with staff raised, small compact blue/gold star circle contained INSIDE right cell with 40px right padding. No body overlap between cells. Every sprite and effect fully visible. TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background, no painted checkerboard, floor, shadow, text or labels. Explicit square pixel clusters and dark crisp outlines; about72x88 logical-pixel sprite enlarged nearest-neighbor. Strong discrete 3-4 shade ramps, sparse ordered dithering. Do not smooth. No blur, no gradient, no antialiasing, no 3D. Do not change identity or palette.
